# tfa

> High-performance, single-binary Rust CLI Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / TOTP / HOTP / Steam Guard) application with OS keyring, age encryption, and headless file storage.

`tfa` provides secure credential storage, RFC 6238 TOTP and RFC 4226 HOTP token generation, Steam Guard support, terminal QR code rendering/scanning, multi-namespace segregation, master password session caching, encrypted backups, and dynamic shell completions across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Complete user documentation, CLI usage examples, configuration formats, and installation guide.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Project architecture, tech stack, coding conventions, and quality gates for AI agents.
- [Man Page](assets/tfa.1): UNIX roff manual page for `tfa`.
- [Full Context (llms-full.txt)](llms-full.txt): Consolidated single-file documentation and specifications for LLMs.

## Core Modules

- [src/main.rs](src/main.rs): CLI entry point, `clap` command definitions, argument resolution, and command dispatch.
- [src/totp.rs](src/totp.rs): RFC 6238 TOTP, RFC 4226 HOTP, and Steam Guard token generation, URI parsing, and secret validation.
- [src/storage.rs](src/storage.rs): Credential storage abstraction across OS `keyring`, `age` encryption, and local `0600` file fallback.
- [src/config.rs](src/config.rs): Hierarchical configuration loading (CLI > Env > TOML/YAML/JSON file > defaults).
- [src/auth.rs](src/auth.rs): Master password protection and sliding-window session unlock caching.
- [src/namespace.rs](src/namespace.rs): Multi-tenant namespace management, switching, and scoping.
- [src/watch.rs](src/watch.rs): Live terminal TOTP countdown progress bars (`watch` and `watch all`).
- [src/qr.rs](src/qr.rs): Terminal ANSI/Unicode QR code rendering, image decoding (`rqrr`), and Google Authenticator migration payloads.
- [src/clipboard.rs](src/clipboard.rs): System clipboard (`arboard`), OSC52 escape sequences, custom clip commands, and auto-clear timeouts.
- [src/audit.rs](src/audit.rs): Security scanner for weak secrets, duplicate seeds, legacy SHA-1 usage, and file permission checks.
- [src/completions.rs](src/completions.rs): Dynamic and static shell completions for Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, and Elvish.

## Backup, Migration & Third-Party Importers

- [src/backup.rs](src/backup.rs): Argon2id + AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption and GPG/OpenPGP backup encryption.
- [src/export.rs](src/export.rs): Encrypted and unencrypted account exporting (JSON, OTPAuth URI list, YAML).
- [src/import.rs](src/import.rs): Multi-format importer (Google Authenticator, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass, Proton, andOTP, Raivo, Stratum, totp-cli).
- [src/migrate.rs](src/migrate.rs): Direct in-memory migration between `keyring`, `file`, and `age` storage backends.
- [src/aegis.rs](src/aegis.rs): Aegis Authenticator JSON/encrypted vault parser and importer.
- [src/ente.rs](src/ente.rs): Ente Auth export parser and importer.
- [src/twofas.rs](src/twofas.rs): 2FAS (`.2fas`) backup parser and importer.

## Build & Automation
